definitions.gloss: first spring gale; first strong south wind of spring
definitions.explanation: The first strong, warm wind from the south each year, blowing between the start of spring on the old calendar (about February 4) and the spring equinox. It is taken as a sign that spring has come.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧、{春一番|はるいちばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
examples.english: The first spring gale blew today.

examples.japanese: {春一番|はるいちばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}ばされた→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧。
examples.english: The laundry was blown away by the first spring gale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{春一番|はるいちばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Meteorological Agency announced that the first spring gale had blown in the Kanto region.

notes:
The Meteorological Agency announces it region by region, and it makes the news each year.
